decision_scope: Static source and test-source review; controlled compile/test outcome is a separate pending evidence gate
observations: Manifest and all three source hashes independently verified. Both production files are byte-identical to reviewed rev1; only collector test source changed.

The previously invalid creation assertion is replaced by missing/malformed SourceBindingHash cases. A valid original intent is then linked against changed-valid SourceBindingHash, TaskID and HostBuildHash receipt contexts, all expected to reject at the actual immutable-context boundary.

Production ordering remains same original Job configuration/query, typed private provenance/actual arguments/plan/environment-hash validation, bounded32KiB O_EXCL intent write/full-length check/Sync/Close/byte-exact readback, live context and only then launch/CreateProcess.

Failure branches retain partial/existing evidence, close owned pipes/Job, return without Native launch and never retry. Final capture links original intent path/bytes SHA256 and immutable context before the wrapper can publish observed qualification.

No public DTO/shared-interface authority expansion, external receipt loader, READY mint, fake model identity or unsandboxed fallback is introduced. Private Go hooks cannot be supplied through product request/JSON/environment.

Fault and ordering fixture sources exercise zero-launch spy for I/O/size/cancel failures, exact write/sync/close/readback ordering, fake-child cleanup and final-intent tampering. Fake child hooks deliberately substitute test-binary argv and do not constitute actual Native execution evidence.
